OPEN FINDING: every entry in the live feeds array returns temperature: 0.1 and humidity: 0 with no variation across 100+ real entries spanning different timestamps, while pressure varies normally and the raw /series field3/field4 values from the same dataset and time range do vary. This suggests the temperature/humidity mapping in the /api/feeds cleanup step is reading the wrong source fields or is otherwise broken — needs a BE look before this route can be trusted for the dashboard. Feeds array truncated to first/last entry for brevity; channel object trimmed to the field-label keys relevant to this contract.

MAJOR FINDING — resolves the placeholder-vs-implemented dispute in mvp-tracker.md: the route has real, layered validation logic, confirmed by walking through it live: rejects an empty body with 'dataset is required when data is not supplied'; rejects a numeric dataset id, requiring the dataset name string instead; requires 'model' to be an object; requires 'model.metric' to be a non-empty canonical metric name (temperature accepted); requires 'correlation' to be an object; requires 'correlation.streams' to contain at least two canonical metric names. Only after passing all of that validation does it fail with ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE — this error could only be reached by actually attempting to call out to the analytics service, so this is NOT a placeholder that echoes the payload back. This confirms Van's PR review comment. The analytics service itself was unreachable in this test environment, so the full success-path response shape is still unconfirmed — that's a separate follow-up, not evidence the route itself is unimplemented.
